## **Can your OT network guard against the unknown?**

][27]

ARIA Zero Trust PROTECT (AZT PROTECT™) is a comprehensive AI driven defense system that protects all
your OT endpoints from ALL cybersecurity threats – known and unknown.

This breakthrough patented solution represents a leap forward in the evolution of cybersecurity,
surpassing anything available today. It protects your entire OT device infrastructure and critical
IT applications no matter their location, safeguarding your revenue and reputation. It automatically
blocks virtually all vulnerabilities from exploit at the application and OS level.

[LEARN MORE][28]

[[ARIA AZT PROTECT Image]][29]

[

### **A Better Approach to Cyber-Attack Detection, Response, and Containment**

][30]
[[Cyber Security Expert]][31]

We took a different path when developing our threat detection and response solutions. Unlike other
providers, we monitor all the network traffic and generate analytics to enable complete
enterprise-wide visibility.

This helps our solutions assist in the identification and disruption of attacks in two important
ways: improve the performance of your existing security stack or deploy automated and full AI-driven
SOC capabilities within a single platform. Customers in a range of industries rely on our solutions
to improve their security posture—no matter their environment.

[Learn More][32]
[

### **AI-SOC Run From the Cloud or On-Premise – The Choice is Yours**

][33]

Our ARIA CloudADR solution is a fully AI-automated, cloud-based virtual SOC that provides an
attractive entry point for companies that need to protect both on-premises and public cloud
infrastructure for pennies on the dollar compared to running a physical SOC. Any ARIA CloudADR can
be upgraded to a full ARIA ADR solution with the deployment of a network-attached platform capable
of detecting and stopping all types of network-borne threats and attacks involving the premises

Both solutions include the equivalent functionality of seven different security tools, all of which
are replaced by more advanced ML-based threat detection models driven by AI. As a result, only
confirmed threats and/or cyber-attacks are presented and stopped in minutes as they become
active—all without human involvement.

[LEARN MORE][34]

# BIBEK JYOTI ROY

Cybersecurity Expert & Serial Entrepreneur

On a mission to build a secure digital world, empowering individuals and businesses against the
ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats.

## / ABOUT ME

Bibek Jyoti Roy is an Indian cybersecurity expert and entrepreneur. He has made significant
contributions in the fields of programming, bug bounty, penetration testing, and Open Source
Intelligence (OSINT). He has helped many companies, such as IND Money and Phind, identify security
vulnerabilities in their systems. In 2021, he founded Psylinks Security, a company dedicated to
providing advanced cybersecurity solutions, and has since expanded into education, blockchain, open
research, and health & wellness sectors with multiple ventures aimed at creating positive societal
impact.

## No. More. Paper. Just blockchain.

Streamline your trade document processing with the CargoX Platform. More than 160,000 companies
trust us with secure document creation, transfer of title, and management. Blockchain-based
documents ensure authenticity, secure audit logs, and confidentiality.

[Transfer icon]
Transfer in seconds

Electronic trade documents travel around the globe in mere seconds, completely eradicating the risk
of delays. With just a single click, businesses can eliminate the need for printers, paper, and
costly courier services, saving valuable time and resources.

[Watch video Details][36]
[Lock icon]
High level security

The neutral, public Ethereum blockchain is used to register documents, transfer possession and
create an audit trail. Military-grade encryption ensures complete security of data, identity and
trade secrets.

[Read more Details][37]
[Savings icon]
Significant cost savings

Eliminate the frustration of failed document delivery and avoid costly delays. Our platform ensures
that your important documents arrive on time, every time.

[Read more Details][38]

## The fastest-growing document ecosystem for businesses and governments

Economic operators and governmental entities rely on the CargoX Platform for secure and efficient
electronic trade document creation, signing, transfer and management. The platform supports over 65
types of documents, including bills of lading, letters of credit, certificates, and more.

Enjoy the flexibility – use plain unstructured documents or pure data (structured documents). The
unbreakable Ethereum blockchain provides confidentiality, security, and transfer of possession
features.

Transfer and manage documents with the highest level of security

Choose CargoX Platform for Blockchain Document Transfer (BDT) – the world’s largest and
fastest-growing solution for the creation and exchange of electronic trade documents. 

Explore our solutions

CargoX solutions are designed to streamline operations, eliminate paper and associated costs, and
ensure documents can be transferred globally in seconds with high-level security. The platform
supports over 65 document types and can be accessed via a web app or integrated using an API.

## No. More. Paper. Just blockchain.

Streamline your trade document processing with the CargoX Platform. More than 160,000 companies
trust us with secure document creation, transfer of title, and management. Blockchain-based
documents ensure authenticity, secure audit logs, and confidentiality.

[Transfer icon]
Transfer in seconds

Electronic trade documents travel around the globe in mere seconds, completely eradicating the risk
of delays. With just a single click, businesses can eliminate the need for printers, paper, and
costly courier services, saving valuable time and resources.

[Watch video Details][36]
[Lock icon]
High level security

The neutral, public Ethereum blockchain is used to register documents, transfer possession and
create an audit trail. Military-grade encryption ensures complete security of data, identity and
trade secrets.

[Read more Details][37]
[Savings icon]
Significant cost savings

Eliminate the frustration of failed document delivery and avoid costly delays. Our platform ensures
that your important documents arrive on time, every time.

[Read more Details][38]

## The fastest-growing document ecosystem for businesses and governments

Economic operators and governmental entities rely on the CargoX Platform for secure and efficient
electronic trade document creation, signing, transfer and management. The platform supports over 65
types of documents, including bills of lading, letters of credit, certificates, and more.

Enjoy the flexibility – use plain unstructured documents or pure data (structured documents). The
unbreakable Ethereum blockchain provides confidentiality, security, and transfer of possession
features.

## Cleura FAQ

What is Cleura Cloud?
Cleura is The European Cloud. We provide open-source based infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS), built
on OpenStack, with all data hosted in certified European data centers.
How is Cleura different from US hyperscalers?
Unlike AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, Cleura is a fully European provider. We are not subject to US
surveillance laws such as FISA 702, which means your data cannot be accessed under extraterritorial
legislation and stays under European legal protection.
Where are Cleura’s data centers located?
Cleura Cloud runs in multiple European regions, including Sweden and Germany, with all
infrastructure certified for security and compliance.
What services does Cleura provide?
We offer compute (VMs), containers, storage, databases, managed services, and training — all
delivered with a focus on digital sovereignty.

### Secure identities.
### Shut out attackers.

Seamlessly secure identities throughout the cycle of accessing any resource across any
infrastructure, including hybrid, SaaS and multi-cloud. The CyberArk identity security platform is
the first line of defense against malicious actors and unauthorized access to protect what matters
most.

[Request a Demo][119]


#### Seamless & secure access for all identities

By combining secure SSO, Adaptive MFA, Lifecycle Management, Directory Services and User Behavior
Analytics, we help you streamline operations and give users simple and secure access to
resources—on-premises, cloud, hybrid—from any location, using any device.


#### Intelligent privilege controls

Apply world-class intelligent privilege controls across the IT estate, as well as differentiated
controls to secure the unique needs of workforce users, third-party vendors, endpoints and machine
identities as they access sensitive data.


#### Flexible identity automation & orchestration

Streamline HR processes, ensure users have the right access to the right resources, enable
compliance with industry or government regulations, and improve efficiencies across the board with
orchestration and lifecycle management, permissions and entitlements, and directory and federation
services.

### Identity Security Defined

Centered on intelligent privilege controls, identity security seamlessly secures access for all
identities and flexibly automates the identity lifecycle with continuous threat detection and
prevention — all with a unified approach.

## Platforms

GCT Minder

GCT Minder is an AI training platform for distributed frontline teams (retail, hospitality,
service), as well as compliance, safety, and technical roles (for example, electricians and field
specialists). It turns customer materials (SOPs, PDFs, short videos, audio) into micro-lessons with
checklists, clear instructions, and quick knowledge checks, and it can also generate lessons
end-to-end—including video—through an AI Copilot flow. The platform is built for rapid rollout and
frequent updates, which matters for operational teams where procedures and standards change often.
Training is delivered by link and can be sent via SMS or WhatsApp—no app, logins, or passwords—so
teams can roll out training through familiar channels. Analytics track completion and performance,
support compliance and operational standardization, and keep training measurable and audit-ready
across distributed teams.

[ Read More ][41]
GCT Cinemix

GCT Cinemix is a generative video studio: you can create a video from a single prompt and then
refine it with the controls teams need in production. The platform supports iteration across text,
images, and video, making it easy to test different approaches and improve results without switching
tools. It lets you guide motion with Frames-to-Video (start/end frames) and reuse characters to keep
a consistent visual style and recognizable identity across a series of videos or campaigns. Projects
and assets are stored and organized in one place, which simplifies access, reuse, and production
operations. For more advanced scenarios, an optional visual canvas lets teams connect steps into
repeatable pipelines, quickly compare variations, lock versions, and review results together.
Built-in compliance checks and transparent credit tracking help keep production predictable and
governed in high-volume or regulated environments.

[ Read More ][42]
GCT Dialog

GCT Dialog is an enterprise platform for building and deploying custom LLMs, interfaces, and agents
on proprietary data—either in the cloud or on-premise. It is designed for enterprise and government
environments where data security, control, and compliance come first. Dialog connects to internal
systems and APIs, enables governed access to proprietary data, and applies role-based access to
sensitive information. The platform supports governance mechanisms such as audit logs and policy
controls, helping teams maintain transparency, oversight, and traceability. When required,
deployment can run in isolated infrastructure with strict segmentation to protect sensitive
workloads and separate environments.

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly
headquarters information directories available online. By continuously monitoring data updates and
verifying corporate details, we make sure the best and most accurate headquarters information is
accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location
details they need, all in one convenient place.

Browse through our carefully selected headquarters listings to quickly locate the company
headquarters you are searching for, whether the organization operates locally, nationally, or
internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users
to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate
headquarters information in just a few clicks.

across our complete headquarters directory. This powerful search feature enables you to instantly
find detailed company headquarters information, including corporate phone numbers, official
addresses, office locations, websites, and additional verified data, all from one centralized
platform.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### How does the connection fee work?

Suppliers quote for free. Only when a buyer accepts your quote do you pay a small fixed fee to
unlock contact details. This fee is intentionally low to encourage high-volume trade.

#### Why start with an anonymous RFQ?

An anonymous RFQ prevents pricing bias. Suppliers provide their best market rates based on your
specifications, not your company size. You only reveal your identity to the partners you choose.

#### Is there really 0% commission on deals?

Yes. HubGate is not a middleman for your payment. Once you connect, you handle the transaction
directly with your partner. We never take a percentage of your deal value.

## Dual Benefits for Buyers & Sellers

HubGate.ae enables clean sourcing for buyers and qualified demand for sellers — without noise,
pressure, or wasted time.

### Procurement Simplified

#### Source Anonymously

Post RFQs anonymously and decide when — and if — your company details are revealed to suppliers.

#### Competitive Pricing

Sellers quote blind, ensuring unbiased, market-driven pricing without brand or size bias.

#### Simple, Instant Comparison

View all quotations side-by-side in one dashboard to make faster, informed decisions.

### Maximize Conversions

#### Qualified Leads

Every RFQ comes from a verified buyer with real purchasing intent — no spam, no cold outreach.

#### Maximum Efficiency

Standardized RFQs mean faster quoting, fewer clarifications, and quicker deal closure.

#### Market Expansion

## Transparent UAE B2B Marketplace Pricing

Post RFQs and connect with suppliers at no cost.
* ✓ Unlimited RFQ posts

* ✓ Direct connections

### Suppliers (Quoting)

No commission. No upfront fees.

Pay only on accepted quotations when you unlock contact.
* ✓ Zero commission on sales

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### How does the connection fee work?

Suppliers quote for free. Only when a buyer accepts your quote do you pay a small fixed fee to
unlock contact details. This fee is intentionally low to encourage high-volume trade.

#### Why start with an anonymous RFQ?

An anonymous RFQ prevents pricing bias. Suppliers provide their best market rates based on your
specifications, not your company size. You only reveal your identity to the partners you choose.

#### Is there really 0% commission on deals?

Yes. HubGate is not a middleman for your payment. Once you connect, you handle the transaction
directly with your partner. We never take a percentage of your deal value.

Built on 30 years of consistent growth, innovation, and trusted partnerships,
Infinigate has evolved from a regional cybersecurity distributor into a global platform spanning
Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific.

With a proven record of double-digit growth, deep technical expertise, and a strong commitment to
collaboration, we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity distribution.

[See key evolutionary milestones][72]

As we celebrate this milestone, we invite partners and vendors to join us in accelerating shared
success, expanding opportunity, and setting new industry standards—together.

[Read blog post][73]

**Our vision is built on one uncompromising belief: that authenticity, purposeful collaboration, and
shared growth are not values to aspire to — they are the only way to build anything that lasts.**

guidance determines the distance between potential and performance. On Your Clicks** exists
**precisely for those moments**, bringing clarity where there is noise, direction where there is
drift, and execution where there are only ideas.

We are **a trusted strategic partner** for **businesses and leaders across industries**, operating
at the intersection of management consulting, executive coaching, and digital innovation.

We do not offer generic frameworks. **We deliver focused, data-informed solutions** that help
**organizations run sharper and leaders think deeper**, because in a world moving at speed,
**precision is the only advantage** that compounds and **essential for every organization to stay
competitive** and **ahead in the game** in dynamic business environment.

## We Offer Digitalization Consulting Services

**Digital transformation is not a technology decision. It is a leadership decision.**

OYC’s **digital practice is built on two decades of hands**-on experience inside multinational
corporations, **navigating complex financial ecosystems, enterprise technology landscapes, and the
organizational realities that no textbook captures.**

**We bring that hard-won clarity** directly to your transformation journey.

We help organizations **accelerate their digital path** with a foundation that is architecturally
sound, commercially affordable, and strategically aligned — delivered through a curated network of
implementation partners who execute at the highest standard.

Our **focus is deliberate: automation and digitalization that simplifies business and financial
processes**, removes friction from operations, and converts complexity into competitive advantage.

Beyond systems and tools, **we guide professionals, emerging leaders, and senior executives through
the decisions that define their digital future** — drawing on decades of real-world experience so
that the right choice is made the first time, not the third.

We call it the First-Time-Right mindset. The discipline of entering every digital decision equipped
with the right data, the right insights, and the clarity to act, not react.

**In a landscape that rewards speed**, those **who decide well once move faster than those who
course-correct twice**.

guidance determines the distance between potential and performance. On Your Clicks** exists
**precisely for those moments**, bringing clarity where there is noise, direction where there is
drift, and execution where there are only ideas.

We are **a trusted strategic partner** for **businesses and leaders across industries**, operating

processes**, removes friction from operations, and converts complexity into competitive advantage.
